tool_calls.name: /bin/zsh -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'PROJECT_BRIEF.md' -g 'go.mod' -g '*resolver*' -g '*clientconn*' | head -200 && git status --short"

/bin/zsh -lc "if [ -f PROJECT_BRIEF.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' PROJECT_BRIEF.md; fi
find .. -name AGENTS.md -print
sed -n '1,260p' resolver/resolver.go
rg -n \"ResolveNow|ReportError|ClientConn|UpdateState|NewAddress|resolver\" clientconn.go resolver_conn_wrapper.go clientconn_test.go resolver_conn_wrapper_test.go | head -240"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '430,610p' clientconn.go
sed -n '500,575p' clientconn.go
sed -n '1,190p' resolver_conn_wrapper.go
sed -n '800,880p' clientconn.go
rg -n \"waitForResolvedAddrs|ErrClientConnTimeout|failfast|getTransport|pick|picker|noSubConn|resolver\" *.go | head -260"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' picker_wrapper.go
sed -n '1,180p' pickfirst.go
sed -n '1,130p' balancer_conn_wrappers.go
sed -n '280,380p' balancer.go
sed -n '1,100p' stream.go
sed -n '280,330p' clientconn.go
git log --all --oneline --decorate -20"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"ReportError|ResolveError|resolver error|could not resolve|firstResolveEvent\" . --glob '"'!vendor/**'"' --glob '"'!*.sum'"'
git log --all -S'ReportError' --oneline -- resolver clientconn.go picker_wrapper.go | head -30
sed -n '1,120p' clientconn.go
sed -n '130,280p' balancer_conn_wrappers.go"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' balancer.go
sed -n '1,130p' balancer_conn_wrappers.go
rg -n \"type V2Balancer|ResolverError|HandleResolvedAddrs\" balancer* *.go"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '40,110p' balancer/base/balancer.go
sed -n '240,330p' balancer/balancer.go
sed -n '240,275p' balancer_v1_wrapper.go
sed -n '1,100p' balancer/base/balancer_test.go 2>/dev/null || true
rg -n \"ReportError\" "'$(go env GOPATH 2>/dev/null)/pkg/mod/google.golang.org/grpc* 2>/dev/null | head -30'

/bin/zsh -lc 'git log --all --oneline -- resolver/resolver.go | head -40
git remote -v'

/bin/zsh -lc "git show --stat --oneline ed563a02 && git show --format=fuller --find-renames ed563a02 -- resolver/resolver.go resolver_conn_wrapper.go clientconn.go balancer_conn_wrappers.go pickfirst.go picker_wrapper.go balancer/base/balancer.go | sed -n '1,320p'"

/bin/zsh -lc 'git cat-file -p ed563a02 | head -20
git ls-tree -r ed563a02 resolver/resolver.go resolver_conn_wrapper.go clientconn.go balancer_conn_wrappers.go pickfirst.go picker_wrapper.go balancer/base/balancer.go'
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff ed563a02''^ ed563a02 -- resolver/resolver.go resolver_conn_wrapper.go clientconn.go balancer_conn_wrappers.go pickfirst.go picker_wrapper.go balancer/base/balancer.go'

/bin/zsh -lc 'git show ed563a02:resolver/resolver.go | rg -n -C 5 "State|ReportError|Err"
git show ed563a02:resolver_conn_wrapper.go | rg -n -C 8 "ReportError|UpdateState|Err"
git show ed563a02:clientconn.go | rg -n -C 8 "updateResolverState|ResolverState.Err|resolverErr|ReportError|picker" | head -180
git show ed563a02:pickfirst.go | rg -n -C 8 "HandleResolvedAddrs|errPicker|err:"'

/bin/zsh -lc "git show ed563a02:balancer_conn_wrappers.go | sed -n '125,155p'
git show ed563a02:clientconn.go 2>&1 | head -20
git show ed563a02:resolver/resolver.go 2>&1 | head -20
for c in 56df169 55dfae6  ed563a02; do git cat-file -t "'$c; done'
file_change
/bin/zsh -lc 'gofmt -w resolver/resolver.go resolver_conn_wrapper.go balancer_conn_wrappers.go pickfirst.go && go test ./resolver/... ./...'
/bin/zsh -lc 'GOCACHE="$PWD/.scratch/go-build" TMPDIR="$PWD/.scratch/tmp" go test ./...'

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"type testClientConn|func \\(.*testClientConn\\).*UpdateState|NewAddress|NewServiceConfig\" resolver/dns resolver -g '*_test.go' | head -80
sed -n '1,100p' resolver/dns/dns_resolver_test.go
sed -n '1,180p' resolver/manual/manual.go 2>/dev/null || true"
file_change
/bin/zsh -lc 'gofmt -w resolver/dns/dns_resolver_test.go && GOCACHE="$PWD/.scratch/go-build" TMPDIR="$PWD/.scratch/tmp" go test -vet=off ./...'

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '35,100p' xds/internal/resolver/xds_resolver_test.go
rg -n \"type testClientConn\" --glob '*_test.go' ."

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '45,90p' xds/internal/balancer/edsbalancer/test_util_test.go
sed -n '150,190p' xds/internal/balancer/xds_test.go"
file_change
/bin/zsh -lc 'gofmt -w xds/internal/resolver/xds_resolver_test.go && GOCACHE="$PWD/.scratch/go-build" TMPDIR="$PWD/.scratch/tmp" go test -vet=off ./...'
/bin/zsh -lc 'mkdir -p .scratch/tmp && GOCACHE="$PWD/.scratch/go-build" TMPDIR="$PWD/.scratch/tmp" go test -vet=off ./...'

/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- resolver/resolver.go resolver_conn_wrapper.go balancer_conn_wrappers.go pickfirst.go resolver/dns/dns_resolver_test.go xds/internal/resolver/xds_resolver_test.go && git status --short'
file_change
/bin/zsh -lc 'GOCACHE="$PWD/.scratch/go-build" TMPDIR="$PWD/.scratch/tmp" go test -vet=off -run '"'"'^$'"' ./... && git diff --check && git diff --stat"
/bin/zsh -lc 'GOCACHE="$PWD/.scratch/go-build" TMPDIR="$PWD/.scratch/tmp" go test -vet=off ./resolver/... ./xds/internal/resolver && git diff --check && git status --short'
